comparison.objective: Swing a wheelchair footrest aside, lift it off a hinge pin, and rest it on a bracket; candidate breaks insert tangs and collects them.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-part rotation, hinge disengagement, lifting, and placement differ from narrow-tool alignment, hammering, fracture-force control, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Footrest removed from its hinge and resting released on the bracket versus four valid fractures with retained inserts and all fragments contained.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanism is removal of a large articulated assembly, not impact finishing of small threaded inserts.
